params.body:
A staff session ends after two idle hours, so a teacher types their password several times a day, and forgetting it is a common reason to get stuck at the sign-in screen.

Two small additions to the staff sign-in screen:

- **Stay signed in.** A checkbox, off by default, with the note that it is only for a device nobody else uses: the staff room computer is shared, and a remembered session there would open for the next person. It uses Laravel's own remember-me, so signing out replaces the token and the cookie left on the device stops working.
- **Who to ask.** Under the password field: "Forgot it? The headmaster can reset it for you." A school has no mail to send a reset link through; the reset already exists in staff management.

No change to how passwords are stored, reset or throttled.

## Checked

- `StaySignedInTest`: the screen offers the choice unticked, a plain sign-in sets no remember cookie or token, a ticked one does, and signing out replaces the token.
- Full suite: 537 tests pass, 2 skipped.
params.title: Sign-in: staff can stay signed in on their own device
